interpreted_intent: Requester-owned: Round loaf remains uncut; Intact exterior visible; Clean wooden table; Record before packing; Only bread and table visible. Authorial choices within open dimensions: Bakery worktable interpretation; Tabletop extends behind loaf; Daylight; Slightly elevated view. A styled bread advertisement and an uncomplicated packing record were considered; the plain record follows the request's practical purpose.
subject: whole uncut round loaf on wooden table
setting: clean wooden bakery worktable before packing
event: round loaf remains uncut before being packed
visual_priorities: uncut loaf retains whole rounded outline
clean wooden table is the only setting shown
baseline_prompt_en: A whole round loaf sits on a clean wooden table, still uncut and ready to be packed. The photograph records its intact exterior before packing, with the complete rounded outline easy to see. Bread and table occupy the frame. The tabletop extends behind the loaf as a plain working surface. Gentle daylight makes the bread's browned surface readable while keeping the scene matter of fact. The view is slightly above table height, giving a clear account of the loaf's top and sides.
